notes: Inbound lead from self-serve signup. Signed up to test hosted API for call summaries / CRM enrichment.
Primary ask: low-friction hosted API that can take Zoom recordings -> transcript -> summary -> push to HubSpot. Wants short TTL for transcripts by default (30-90 days).

PII concerns: recordings contain customer phone numbers, occasional partial SSNs, credit card fragments. Wants configurable redaction at ingestion and pattern-based scrubbing. Quote: 'We can't store PII longer than necessary; need clear deletion flow.'
Retention requirements: default 30-90 days, ability to set per-customer/tenant retention, manual deletion API, and audit logs showing deletion events.
Security: asks for SOC2 report, audit logging for transcript access, optional KMS for keys (would be nice but not a blocker for initial pilot).
Cost sensitivity: small team, worried about token-based costs for long meeting histories. Interested in batching suggestions and caching to reduce repeated token costs.
Integration: HubSpot CRM push must include meeting summary + action items + key contacts (need field mappings). They asked if Redwood has example HubSpot connectors or webhooks.

Technical constraints: mostly Zoom recordings (mp4) and some direct audio streaming. Sequence lengths moderate (5-20 min calls), peak concurrency low (5-10 concurrent requests). Latency tolerance ~2-4s for summary creation is fine (not real-time chat).
Requested artifacts: security FAQ, example retention policy, minimal SSO/SAML guidance (for later), pricing estimate for 12 seats (monthly).
Next: send security FAQ + sample retention docs, follow-up call (SE + AE) week of 2026-03-08 to scope PII redaction options and demo HubSpot mapping.
